nom: ROUND LAB Pine Calming Cica Ampoule

avis.titre: Not sure how much this helped.
avis.texte: I haven't noticed much of a difference in my skin. My skin feels soft, but I'm still dealing with blemishes. I've only been using it for about a month so I'm not sure if it needs more time to work.

very targeted treatment, worked wonderfully for soothing and eliminating the bacteria on my brother's inflamed skin from intense acne. Recommend only for oily skin, can be drying if used on dry or mature skin.
The product is so splendid. I really love it. I'm going to get it again.

This serum is amazing for calming down redness and those pesky hormonal breakouts without any stinging. It's incredibly hydrating, but it does leave a slightly sticky feeling on the skin for a short while. To keep it in place, I just apply my moisturizer right after.

I started trying a Korean skincare again because my skin wasn't improving on the typical western skincare and round lab showed me a great improvement on my skin like it was when I was using a different Korean brand.
It works well easy to apply and helps calm redness and improves my skin quality. The only bad thing it it runs out quick.
This ampoule leaves my skin feeling hydrated and calms my skin. I have combination skin prone to acne. I think I even see my skin appear brighter.

this ampoule is amazing for calming redness. ever since 1 summer when I refused to wear sunscreen & had a massive sunburn on my face, my cheeks become really red easily. even on days with no makeup, it looks like two giant red puffs of a reaction. this ampoule helps calm it to look less inflamed & it's great for immediate results! i love it for my sensitive skin & definitely need to purchase a larger bottle.

avis.titre: Been using this for a few
avis.texte: Been using this for a few months now, a must have for skin care routine.

I was looking for a centella product to help calm and hydrate my skin when using tret! I've tried sandwiching my tret with really heavy moisturizers but still had dryness after use. With this serum applied before my tret, I didn't have any irritation the following days! It has a great texture and slip. Am excited to keep using it and also try it in a clay mask

I knew I needed this because I love all things cica for my redness-prone skin. I'd only used Dr Jart cica products and this ranks as highly as far as efficacy and more highly in terms of value. Will definitely be buying this item and others in the line in the future.

Live in a place where it frequently is next to now humidity and above 100 degree temps— this pine cica manages to keep my sensitive skin redness free and properly moisturized. Feels incredibly soothing and nice being applied, I layer on my cheeks twice. Just a tiny drop and pat on. My facial skin used to look reminiscent of a cooked lobster in the summer. Now it's significantly clearer, less inflamed, and with better elasticity and texture, due in no small part, to the pine cica ampoule. Worth it a million times over. Wish I could get a bigger bottle of it, haha
I bought it to help control inflammation and it seems to help so far.
This serum helped tame my wild acne and soothe my irritated skin. Really good stuff.

Clean ingredients: no alcohol, no fragrance, and no microplastic ingredients. It is hard to find such clean formulas in this day and age, even their other products have some alcohols and ingredients that made me frown, but this serum is good! It absorbs nicely into the skin and makes it look more supple and hydrated. I have noticed it helps reduce inflammation and keep my skin more clear. Cute packaging too :) I only wish it was more affordable, since it only lasts me a month or two and the cost adds up.
This ampoule got rid of acne on my forehead. On areas where my acne is a bit worse like my cheeks, it's still working it's magic. It is also hydrating on my skin.
I struggle with nodular acne caused by bacteria and this serum helps keep breakouts at bay!
As everyday product, as product to calm skin, as a product for acne or sensitive skin.. so many reasons to use it and enjoy the benefits. I adore this product.

I've been using this ampoule for several months now as part of my serum routine. I couldn't love this ampoule more due to its silky, yet non-sticky texture. It smoothes over my skin effortlessly and helps to tone down the redness on my rosacea-prone cheeks. This is the perfect complement to your daily/nightly skin care routine, and if you've been on the fence about whether an ampoule is worth adding to your skincare repertoire, it's a no-brainer. I should also mention that I'm in my early 50s and live in a very dry mountain climate, so using products that hydrate is a must for me.
I'm going to be switching from CosRx to Roundlab. I've only been using this 2 weeks and already my skin is so much healthier!
Love this product. Thrid time buying it. It really does help with itchy sensitive skin.
Added softness and reduces redness. Calms my slightly irritated skin after cleansing. Also smells wonderful!
I love this Ampoule. Within minutes it reduces redness. Scent is almost unnoticeable which I like. Slippery texture but absorbs easily and works great under moisturizer. Will Be buying again!
Bought for my son to help with acne and his skin has cleared a lot so far

It's really work. After an active day, it soothes my skin well. It also relieves redness. It resembles sheet mask by round lab. I really like them too, but if you don't have enough time for mask, it will be good alternative

People don't talk enough about how this whole line contains LHA, a gentler derivative of salicylic acid. All the benefits of BHA for acne and deep pore cleaning without the associated dryness. Perfect for my sensitive, dry & acne-prone skin. Hydrating and calming too. Love this line and will keep this in my routine long term

avis.titre: Not sure if I like it yet...
avis.texte: I use this every other day and it haven't wow me yet. I can't say it does a great job at removing my sebum because I haven't noticed anything major. Will continue to use this but as of right now it is not on my to repurchase list.

Honestly the best serum I ever had and I tried a lot different brands from different budget segments. My irritation was gone in couple days after usage, my acne got visibly better after a week. Also cream from this collection is magic as well.

This is a perfect compliment to my normal serum routine. It has a super smooth, silky feel and blends in quickly without feeling sticky. I'd originally received a sample in a previous order (love those samples) and immediately knew I'd be ordering this. Excited to try more of the Pine Calming Cica line.

First time purchasing this and it makes my skin feel very smooth. I have sensitive skin and seen any major breakouts but it has helped with my dry skin during the winter season. Will continue to use this as part of my regular routine.
I love the Pine Tree line!! I have sensitive and acne prone skin and this product works so well for me! The ampoule is light and thin but so hydrating and calming. No smell which I love as well.

avis.titre: Love it! Will be buying again
avis.texte: I love this particular serum. I have never used a serum before, and I think this serum is worth buying. I have hormonal acne and dry skin plus acne scars, so I think this is a great last step in my skincare routine. It leaves my skin feeling moisturized and firm (like the hydration is locked in).

avis.titre: light formula that def calms my irritated skin
avis.texte: I took the skincare quiz and they recommended me the pine cica collection, which is targeted towards those with sensitive and inflamed skin! I am currently trying this product and the lotion and I definitely noticed a difference! my skin doesn't get as red after applying and the formula is so light and thin yet hydrating! I also suffer from hormonal acne but my breakouts aren't as bad anymore!

avis.titre: Great Product For Those With Rosacea
avis.texte: I was gifted this and it really helped clear up my acne. Glad to find a product for people with sensitive skin!
Feels very nice on the skin, makes it feel plump and its not sticky
Really wanted to like this product, but it made my skin red and irritated.

This product gave me the WORST acne of my life; even worse than my cystic hormonal acne. I switched over my skin care routine (slowly) to using Round Lab after seeing this advertised all over. At first I assumed my skin must be purging with how awful the acne was, but 6 weeks and two periods later my skin looks disgusting. All this did was keep me from wanting to go to social events or take pictures for 6+ weeks (not to mention I'm now spending hundreds to fix this). I do NOT recommend for any type of acne prone skin.

avis.titre: My second time using this product
avis.texte: It's my second time using this product. I have really sensitive skin and acne is my problem. I used this ampoule for first few days, literally I saw results so quickly. Now my skin is getting better. There is almost no acne on my face because i think the ampoule calming my skin. Personally I would buy it again and again.

The texture is thicker than I expected and feels a bit heavy on my combination/oily skin type. But it's very soothing and hydrating and very effective in calming blemishes (I personally like its sheet mask more). It's used up very quickly, and I wish there were different sizes.

It does have actually a calming effect, and I personally use not everyday but when I feel it or when my skin have trouble like acne, or when I shave my facial hair, or after I exfoliate, so this serum helps me to not have irritation.

If you have any signs of trouble on your face or body, apply a generous amount beforehand. In particular, if you are irritated by something and have a red rash or have signs of acne, get it in advance! It's a small amount, but it's really good~ (I already used half again.. ㅠㅜ)

I received a sample size of this with a previous order. I struggle with combination skin and hormonal acne. I have been using this product for 6 weeks. I did have a slight purge for the first 5 weeks, but nothing worse than what I've experienced in the past. At week 6, my breakouts have finally calmed and my texture + redness is going away. I have not added anything else new to my routine, so I know that this specific product is what finally helped me after I felt like nothing would. It is slightly thick and sometimes dries tacky feeling, but I don't mind as this is part of my night routine. I use it 3x/week and it never causes any dryness, super hydrating actually! I love this product!

This serum is amazing at calming down inflamed, angry skin. I use it every day but double up when I have active breakouts and it makes my skin much less sensitive. Over time I've also noticed that it seems to help with hyperpigmentation and reducing redness overall in my face.
Wonderful overall calming affect on skin, but has been amazing at clearing the Rosacea on my cheeks. After only a week of use, the redness is significantly diminished.
I love this serum! It looks exactly like in the photos, so cute, totally recommend :)
This ampoule really did help with my breakouts and saw a big difference when I used it. Grateful to have found this product.

My skin is less irritated after using this ampoule. It also provided a nice boost of hydration and left my skin feeling soft. The texture of the ampoule is lightweight and absorbs quickly into the skin without leaving any greasy residue. Anyone with sensitive or irritated skin should definitely try the ROUND LAB Pine Tree Soothing Cica Ampoule. It is gentle, effective, and provides noticeable results. I wish the size was bigger, as I use it too quickly.

I have the pine cleanser, toner, ampoule, and cream. I wasn't sure how much of a difference they were making until I missed a night of skincare and my redness returned with full force by the morning. I will live and die with this product on my face.
Love this cooling texture. it absorbs quickly and feels smoothing on the skin

I used the sample first, liked it, and bought it during the sale period. I think the effect is not dramatic but it gently works on my skin. :) No scent not even a slight chem smell. It's not sticky, but more like water type. So, it absorbs into my skin nicely. Love it!
Moisturizing and does not irritate my skin. Perfect for redness and acnes

Bought two of these off of OliveYoung and have been using them for a little more than a month. They definitely calm my skin and have helped reduced redness! Only downside is, and I'm not totally sure it's this specific product, I have been getting little white bumps over my skin(no other changes to my routine, just this ampoule). Definitely will keep using though, as it could totally be something else like diet.
I have sensitive and acne-prone skin and love how this is helping decrease my redness. It absorbs well and doesn't cause any additional irritation for me.

I've been using this product for several weeks paired with the pine cream and noticed my facial redness decrease and my skin feels smoother. I like the way it feels on the skin but I do not think I will be repurchasing because I have some new breakouts in parts of my face that usually don't break out, it might just be my skin reacting to a new product but it's been about two months and it's still happening
I really love this product. It spreads well over the skin. Not overly sticky and absorbs well. Does not bother my sensitive skin.
Fast delivery! Just received this one and excited to try this. Esp now during summer when my skin need some calming ingredients
Fast delivery! Just received this one and excited to try this. Esp now during summer when my skin need some calming ingredients
super lightweight & moisturising. soothe my irritated skin :))

This serum does a good job at calming down my sensitive skin, especially since I'm using retinol. It's one of those serums where you actually feel like you're putting product onto your skin instead of it disappearing the moment it touches your skin and feeling dry. I like to keep the serum in the fridge to enhance the calming effect on my skin. Overall, this is now my new favorite serum, and looks amazing with makeup since it's moisturizing (fyi my skin type is oily).

avis.titre: Worked wonders in clearing up skin issues
avis.texte: It cleared up both my rosacea and psoriasis. It helped to get rid of the redness and irritated look of my skin too,
My skin appears and feels more moisturized in the morning than it typically does with other products. Well I really enjoy this the smell kind of throws me off.

avis.titre: Amazing Ampoule - Wakes Up Tired and Dehydrated Skin
avis.texte: Bought this pine tree cica ampoule because my skin looked tired and dehydrated, and the results are amazing. After just using it daily for one week my skin looks more hydrated (probably because of the hylauronic acid), more firm, and more healthy. Its not sticky and absorbs quickly into the skin; there is no smell; and it layers well with other sRead more about review stating Amazing Ampoule - Wakes Up Tired and Dehydrated Skinerums and sunscreen. I havent finished my first bottle yet, but given the results I am looking forward to repurchasing this ampoule again and making it part of my skincare routine.

avis.titre: Cool unscented and quick to absorb serum.
avis.texte: Cool unscented and quick to absorb serum. I was worried that it would smell too much like pines but no, it doesn't smell at all ,which is great for sensitive skin. Used it as my morning serum and so far, did not have any acne break out.

avis.titre: I like it as it cools down skin well.
avis.texte: Not dramatic soothing effect, but I like it as it cools down skin well.

avis.titre: Really helps with my sensitive acne prone skin.
avis.texte: Really helps with my sensitive acne prone skin. My face feels soothed after I apply this serum.

avis.titre: This is a great soothing ampoule.
avis.texte: This is a great soothing ampoule. Some people think it's too watery but I think it's great and moisturising nevertheless
I am still testing, have been using this ampoule for only two weeks so far. But feels like it helps to soothe and moisturize. It has a watery and soft texture.

avis.titre: Im in love with this line of Round Lab!
avis.texte: Im in love with this line of Round Lab! This set helped calmed down my acne prone and oily skin throughout the summer. The serum has a lightweight gel texture and absorbs very fast into the screen. The sample cream also has a lightweight texture and doesnt feel greasy at all.
